flow.field: For nonzero position p: outward=p.normalized(); clockwise_tangent=Vector2(-outward.y,outward.x); flow=tangent*tangential_speed-outward*inward_speed. Use one combined vector, never apply cap per axis.
flow.ramp: t=clamp(stage_clock/35,0,1); interpolate total cap and inward speed start→end, tangent=sqrt(total_cap^2-inward_speed^2). Same time-varying field for hero and floating props. Starts immediately during harmless gag and strengthens continuously.

flow.airborne_props: FINAL Engineering decision: fixed worldXY during vertical fall, not advected or retargeted in air. Locked impact ring and actual shadow stay exactly below object. Floating props advect after impact. This supersedes interim airborne-flow proposals.

Once announced, never move a target, silently drop props or accumulate a delayed burst. If no safe full formation is found, report validation failure; do not claim this seed passed.
